I'd expect nothing less from you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle

Ufufu...!

makes me super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Very, very thank you!
I feel so, so good today, YES!
